items.body: Attacker fixes a session ID before user login; app accepts it without regeneration, letting attacker hijack authenticated session.

items.claim: Session Timeout Bypass via Missing Cookie Regeneration
items.body: Idle/absolute timeout not enforced or session cookie not invalidated on logout; extended reuse possible.
Server trusts header-specified alg without validation; switching to none or HS256 with attacker key grants forged session.
Logout does not destroy server-side session or clear cookie; captured cookie reused by attacker.
CSRF token not bound to session or single-use; token replayed across requests to force state-changing actions.

items.claim: XS-Leaks Session Sniffing via Cross-Site Leak
items.body: Cross-origin timing/size channels infer authenticated content; session IDs leaked without user interaction.

items.claim: Chain: Auth Bypass to Account Takeover
items.body: Session fix + JWT alg confusion combined yield credential-free account takeover; requires correlated session tracking.
Login does not issue new session ID; pre-auth session survives into authenticated context (fixation window remains open).
